line_budget.counting: Tracked nonblank source implementation lines under src/leibniz in categories marked handwritten-implementation. Contract-runtime support, contract files, tests, fixtures, package metadata, lockfiles, build configuration, generated outputs, and repository automation are excluded.

graph_projection.description: The inventory is intended to project to a source graph: path nodes are categorized by category nodes, contract-surface nodes own runtime/test/generated-output paths, and structural-marker nodes justify excluded implementation-adjacent runtime support.

categories.name: contract-ratchet-inventory
categories.scope: Hand-authored inventory of code categories, contract generation status, and line-budget ratchet configuration.
categories.ratchet_next: Replace inventory-only tracking with authored contracts that can generate Python, TypeScript, and conformance tests.

categories.name: packaging-and-repository-automation

categories.name: python-foundation

categories.name: python-contract-runtime

categories.ratchet_next: Keep this layer narrow and contract-generic while domain record declarations move toward authored contracts and generated runtimes.

categories.name: python-package-metadata

categories.ratchet_next: Keep packaging markers explicit and outside implementation-line accounting.
